text: Quick-start CLI/tutorial builds and scaffolds a working agent (model+instructions+tools) in minutes
quote: Go from idea to coded ADK agent in minutes. Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.

text: Define an agent with a model, instructions, and a list of tools in a short code snippet
quote:
agent = Agent(
    name="researcher",
    model="gemini-flash-latest",
    instruction="You help users research topics thoroughly.",
    tools=[google_search],
)

text: Expand simple agents into workflows that combine and orchestrate multiple agents and code-execution tasks
quote: you can use the ADK development framework to expand them into workflows, which allow you to combine and orchestrate multiple agents and code execution tasks

text: An ADK agent can act as an MCP client, using tools exposed by external MCP servers
quote: An ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools provided by external MCP servers.

text: ADK tools can be wrapped and exposed via an MCP server for any MCP client to use
quote: Exposing ADK Tools via an MCP Server: How to build an MCP server that wraps ADK tools, making them accessible to any MCP client.

text: Agent Runtime is a fully managed, auto-scaling Google Cloud service for deploying and scaling ADK agents
quote: Agent Runtime is a fully managed auto-scaling service on Google Cloud specifically designed for deploying, managing, and scaling AI agents built with frameworks such as ADK.

text: Agents can run fully offline/disconnected from Google Cloud
quote: This is a good option if you prefer to run offline or disconnected, or otherwise in a system that has no connection to Google Cloud.

text: Individual test files can encode single agent-model interactions (sessions) for unit-testing agents during development
quote: This approach involves creating individual test files, each representing a single, simple agent-model interaction (a session).

text: Agent Config lets you build agents without writing code
quote: Agent Config: Build agents without code.

text: Tool confirmation flow lets a human explicitly approve or supply custom input before a tool executes
quote: Tool Confirmation: A tool confirmation flow (HITL) that can guard tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input.

text: Built-in development UI to test, evaluate, debug, and showcase agents
quote: A built-in development UI to help you test, evaluate, debug, and showcase your agent(s).

text: Web UI can point at multi-agent directories or a single agent folder, launched via CLI
quote: Web UI (supports multi-agent directories or pointing directly to a single agent folder)

text: ADK exposes AI-aware developer resources/Skills so coding assistants can build ADK agents directly
quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources

text: Graph-based Workflow Runtime composes deterministic execution flows with routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state, dynamic nodes, HITL, and nested workflows
quote: Workflow Runtime: A graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic execution flows for agentic apps, with support for routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic nodes, human-in-the-loop, and nested workflows.

text: ADK automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage to manage context
quote: ADK automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage.

text: Cloud Run can host an agent as a managed, auto-scaling container-based deployment
quote:
Deploying the Agent in Google Cloud (Cloud Run)

adk deploy cloud_run --with_ui <agent-folder>

text: ADK works with Gemini and, via adapters, many other model providers including locally running models
quote: ADK can work with almost any generative AI model. The framework provides easy access to Gemini as well as other leading models, and we provide adapters that let you connect with many other models and model providers, including locally runni

text: CLI command 'adk run' runs an agent from the terminal
quote: adk run path/to/my_agent

text: Task API supports structured agent-to-agent delegation, single/multi-turn modes, mixed patterns, HITL, and tasks as workflow nodes
quote: Task API: Structured agent-to-agent delegation with multi-turn task mode, single-turn controlled output, mixed delegation patterns, human-in-the-loop, and task agents as workflow nodes.

text: GKE deployment option gives more control over deployment and supports running open models
quote: GKE is a good option if you need more control over the deployment as well as for running Open Models.

text: ADK provides groundtruth-based and rubric-based tool-use evaluation metrics
quote: ADK provides both groundtruth based and rubric based tool use evaluation metrics.

text: Agents can be manually packaged into a container image and run in any container-supporting environment
quote: You can manually package your Agent into a container image and then run it in any environment that supports container images.

text: Evaluations can compare an expected intermediate tool-use trajectory against the agent's actual steps
quote:
expected_steps = ["determine_intent", "use_tool", "review_results", "report_generation"]
actual_steps = ["determine_intent", "use_tool", "review_results", "report_generation"]

text: CLI command 'adk eval' runs an eval set against an agent, suitable for CI
quote:
adk eval \
    samples_for_testing/hello_world \
    samples_for_testing/hello_world/hello_world_eval_set_001.evalset.json

text: CLI command 'adk deploy docker --with_ui' deploys/runs the agent locally in a Docker container
quote: adk deploy docker --with_ui <agent-folder>

text: Plugins let you integrate complex, pre-packaged behaviors and third-party services into an agent's workflow
quote: Plugins: Integrate complex, pre-packaged behaviors and third-party services directly into your agent's workflow.

text: Prebuilt or custom Agent Skills extend agent capabilities while staying within context-window limits
quote: Use prebuilt or custom Agent Skills to extend agent capabilities in a way that works efficiently inside AI context window limits.

text: Callbacks hook into agent execution lifecycle events for logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects
quote: Callbacks: Hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle to add logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects without altering core agent logic.

text: ADK is available as SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin
quote: Available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin.

text: Rich tool ecosystem: pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, and MCP tools can be given to agents
quote: Rich Tool Ecosystem: Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities

text: Code-first development: define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for flexibility, testability, versioning
quote: Code-First Development: Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.

text: No hard requirement to move from single-agent to multi-agent/graph-based workflow architecture
quote: ADK does not impose any hard requirements to move from a single-agent architecture to a multi-agent or graph-based Workflow architecture.

text: Artifacts let agents create and manage persistent outputs (files, code, documents) beyond the conversation lifecycle
quote: Artifacts: Enable agents to create and manage persistent outputs like files, code, or documents that exist beyond the conversation lifecycle.

text: Existing agents and workflows can be migrated into ADK using the Agents CLI
quote: Migrate existing agents and workflows to ADK with Agents CLI.
